harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created the appworker account on node1 and configured login-session limits of 8192 open files and 256 processes via /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf, verified with pam_limits-backed login sessions. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, triggered a deferred-ack reboot, confirmed the node went down and came back with a new boot_id, and re-verified the account and limits persisted after restart.
actions_performed: Checked appworker did not already exist on node1
Created appworker user with useradd -m -s /bin/bash
Wrote /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf with soft/hard nofile=8192 and soft/hard nproc=256
Confirmed pam_limits.so is enabled in relevant /etc/pam.d session stacks (login, sshd, su, sudo, etc.)
Verified via 'su - appworker' that ulimit -n=8192 and ulimit -u=256
Captured baseline boot_id and uptime on node1
Triggered a deferred reboot (sleep 2; reboot) so the exec call acknowledged before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec became available again
Confirmed boot_id changed and uptime -s reset, proving an actual restart
Re-verified appworker account, limits config file, and effective ulimits post-restart

evidence.summary: Confirmed no pre-existing appworker user, then created it and confirmed uid=1000(appworker).

evidence.requirement: Login sessions limited to 8192 open files and 256 processes
evidence.summary: Wrote limits.d config for nofile=8192/nproc=256, confirmed pam_limits is wired into session stacks, and a live login session (su -) showed ulimit -n=8192 and ulimit -u=256.
Captured pre-restart boot_id (29011044-...) and uptime start (08:49:48) as the baseline boot identity.
Backgrounded a delayed reboot so the exec call returned 'triggered' immediately, prior to the node going down.

evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: Boot_id was unchanged, then the node became unreachable (connection timed out) confirming the reboot occurred, then reappeared with a new boot_id (d2b40e33-...) and new uptime start (08:50:20).

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required account/data state
evidence.summary: After restart, appworker account, limits.d config file, and effective ulimits (8192 files / 256 processes) were all confirmed intact via a fresh login session.
